command.label: tla
command.help: Usage: tla 'outdir' [K] [seed]; writes K mutated states of the current state, USE's invariant values on them, and a TLA+ translation of the model's invariants and states to 'outdir'.

command.label: tlaops
command.help: Usage: tlaops (settings file | default) 'outdir' [module]; translates the operations of the model under the settings into a TLA+ specification for TLC.
